newsitem.title: CANADA: Orvana Minerals reports drill results.
newsitem.headline: Orvana Minerals reports drill results.

text.p: Orvana Minerals Corp said on Wednesday it has completed the first part of a 10,000-metre drill program at its gold project in Bolivia.
The Vancouver-based company said it has results from an initial 6,500 metres on the Pampa zone at its 50-percent owned Pederson project.
The results showed a continuity of ore grade that is amenable to bulk mining, Orvana said in a statement.
The drilling also showed that mineralization is open to the west and to the north of recent holes.
Two new areas of mineralization were discovered on the east side, and assays for that area are pending, the company said.
Gold grades measured between 0.72 grams per tonne to 3.89 grams per tonne in thicknesses between three metres and 64 metres, the company's figures showed.
Orvana said assays for another 31 holes are pending.
